'''Galdovar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] Intelligence agent who was in contact with [[Hallena Devis]] on [[JanFathal]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Athar]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="NP" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> he contacted Devis about [[Merish Hath]] and [[Shil Kaval]] who were serving as allies to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. He was able to give her a code name, known as [[Orla Taman]].<ref name="NP" />
